# @darcas/rollup-sub-resource-integrity

> A zero-dependency Rollup/Vite plugin that adds Subresource Integrity (SRI) attributes to your HTML
> files. SRI lets browsers verify that scripts and stylesheets are served without unexpected
> manipulation, protecting users against CDN compromises and supply-chain tampering.

- Package: `@darcas/rollup-sub-resource-integrity`
- Type: Rollup plugin (Vite-compatible), Node.js >= 18
- License: MIT
- Website: https://sri.os.darcas.app
- Repository: https://github.com/DarCas/rollup-sub-resource-integrity
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@darcas/rollup-sub-resource-integrity

## Overview

`SubResourceIntegrity` is a single-file Rollup plugin that runs during the `generateBundle` phase.
It scans every HTML file emitted by the build, locates `<script src>` and
`<link rel="stylesheet|preload|modulepreload">` tags whose URI resolves to an asset in the same
bundle, hashes the in-memory content, and injects an `integrity` attribute. When a `crossorigin`
attribute is missing it is added as `crossorigin="anonymous"`, because browsers ignore `integrity`
on cross-origin requests without a CORS attribute.

The plugin has **zero runtime dependencies** since v2.0.0: HTML rewriting uses a targeted regex
rather than a DOM parser.

## Features

- Zero runtime dependencies.
- Automatically calculates integrity hashes for `*.htm` and `*.html` assets.
- Multiple hashing algorithms: `sha256`, `sha384` (default), `sha512`.
- Adds `crossorigin="anonymous"` automatically when missing.
- Integrates seamlessly into the Rollup/Vite build process.
- Uses a targeted regex over resource tags — no DOM parser required.
- External URIs (`http(s):`, protocol-relative, `data:`) and resources missing from the bundle are
  silently skipped.

## Installation

```bash
npm i -D @darcas/rollup-sub-resource-integrity
```

Or with yarn:

```bash
yarn add @darcas/rollup-sub-resource-integrity --dev
```

> Since v2 the plugin has zero runtime dependencies; upgrading from v1 requires no code changes.

## Usage

In your `vite.config.mts` (or Rollup config):

```ts
import SubResourceIntegrity from '@darcas/rollup-sub-resource-integrity';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
    plugins: [
        // ...
        SubResourceIntegrity(),
        // ...
    ],
});
```

### Configuration

The plugin accepts an optional parameter to select the hashing algorithm. Default is `sha384`.

```js
SubResourceIntegrity('sha512');
```

Supported algorithms:

- `sha256`
- `sha384` (default)
- `sha512`

## How It Works

1. During the `generateBundle` phase, the plugin scans the emitted HTML assets in the bundle.
2. It looks for resource tags (`<script src>` and `<link rel="stylesheet|preload|modulepreload">`)
   whose URI matches a file in the same bundle.
3. For each match:
   - The content is taken from the in-memory bundle (no disk access) and hashed with the selected
     algorithm.
   - An `integrity` attribute is added to the tag.
   - `crossorigin="anonymous"` is added when missing.
4. External URIs and resources missing from the bundle are silently skipped.

## Migrating from v1 to v2

No code changes are required — the API and usage stay identical. Changes under the hood:

- **Zero runtime dependencies** — `cheerio` removed.
- **In-memory processing.** Hook moved from `writeBundle` to `generateBundle`.
- **`crossorigin="anonymous"` added automatically** when missing.
- **Node.js >= 18** required.
